newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed to weaker, market awaits RPI.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed to weaker, market awaits RPI.

text.p: Top British shares opened mixed to weaker on Thursday, weighed down by another fall on Wall Street and concerns over a possible interest rate rise on both sides of the Atlantic, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 share index opened 9.1 points lower at 4,323.1 at 0830 GMT, with the FTSE 250 index of mid-cap shares down 4.9 points at 4,648.0.

Dealers said the market would remain nervous ahead of UK retail prices data at 0930 GMT, in the wake of a strong batch of data on Wednesday which revived concerns that interest rates would rise soon after Britain's May 1 general election.
